The '''Nicandra sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Ilimardon system/Legends|Ilimardon]], [[Melus system/Legends|Melus]], [[Nicandra system/Legends|Nicandra]], [[Octavia system/Legends|Octavia]], and [[Yde system/Legends|Yde systems]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], whose [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] traveled through the sector that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to [[Orinda campaign|fight]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
The Nicandra [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="NewTerritories" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] [[spinward]], the [[Kordu sector/Legends|Kordu]] and [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The westernmost section of the Nicandra sector contained the [[Nicandra system/Legends|Nicandra]], [[Octavia system/Legends|Octavia]], and [[Yde system/Legends|Yde systems]], while the [[Ilimardon system/Legends|Ilimardon]] and [[Melus system/Legends|Melus systems]] lay in the more eastward portions of the sector.<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Nicandra [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] of [[Nicandra system/Legends|Nicandra]], [[Octavia system/Legends|Octavia]], and [[Yde system/Legends|Yde]] in grid square L-7 and [[Ilimardon system/Legends|Ilimardon]] and [[Melus system/Legends|Melus]] in square M-7, which correspond to the westernmost and the more eastward sections of the sector, respectively, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}.</ref> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] ran through the Ilimardon and Nicandra [[Star system/Legends|systems]], connecting the sector to the Hollan and Kordu sectors. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, running through the Hollan and M'shinni sectors, also passed through the Nicandra system.<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Nicandra sector fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic dispatched the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] to [[Orinda campaign|fight]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. To that end, the ''Endurance'' traveled from the [[Mapuzo system/Legends|Mapuzo system]] in the Hollan sector to the Kordu sector's [[Korvaii system/Legends|Korvaii system]], passing through the Nicandra sector in the process.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Locations==
The Yde system<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the astronomical object of the [[Yde|same name]],<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> while the Octavia system was the origin point of the [[Octavian fruit pudding]].<ref name="Planet Plague">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Octavian fruit pudding]]|system=[[Octavia system/Legends|Octavia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> The Melus system shared its name with the [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]] conflict [[Melusi Uprising]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and the Nicandra system was the eponym for the [[Nicandra Plaza]] and the [[Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building/Legends|Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building]], both located on the Core Worlds [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Labyrinth">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> The Ilimardon system was the site of the planet [[Ilimardon]], which was governed by the [[Regal Hierarchy]] and maintained a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020425amynocks&c=rpg|text=Domesticated Mynocks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nicandra sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares L-7 and M-7.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
